```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(here); library(tidyverse)})
source(here("R/helpers/report_tools.R"))
first_comment = function(f) {
  x = readLines(here(f), warn = FALSE)
  x = x[startsWith(x, '#') & !grepl('^#\\s*[=-]{5,}', x)]
  x = sub('^#+\\s?', '', x)
  x = x[nzchar(trimws(x))]
  sub('^[0-9]{2} ', '', x[1])
}
```

## How to run

```sh
Rscript R/run_all.R --offline      # rebuild everything from the cached climate in output/cache/
Rscript R/run_all.R                # same, downloading any missing CHELSA chunks
Rscript R/run_all.R --age-models   # also refit the four Bacon chronologies (about 5 minutes)
Rscript R/run_all.R --presentation # also draw the presentation figures
Rscript R/build_report.R           # rebuild this report from the outputs
```

`R/run_all.R` runs the pipeline steps in order, then every figure script, the worked examples and
the tests. A step reads only what earlier steps wrote. `output/` is not tracked by git; a clean
rebuild needs only the raw data in `data/` and `Cores/` and the climate cache in `output/cache/`
(or a network connection). Software: R with the packages loaded at the top of each script, rbacon
3.5.2, and `pdftoppm` (poppler) for the report.

## Pipeline

```{r}
steps = c(sort(list.files(here('R/pipeline'), '^[0-9]{2}_.*[.]R$', full.names = TRUE)),
  sort(list.files(here('R/figures'), '^supp_.*[.]R$', full.names = TRUE)),
  sort(list.files(here('R/figures'), '^main_.*[.]R$', full.names = TRUE)),
  here('R/worked_examples.R'), sort(list.files(here('R/tests'), '^test_.*[.]R$', full.names = TRUE)))
tibble(Script = sub(paste0(here(), '/'), '', steps)) |>
  mutate(Role = case_when(startsWith(Script, 'R/pipeline') ~ 'pipeline', startsWith(Script, 'R/figures') ~ 'figure',
    startsWith(Script, 'R/tests') ~ 'test', TRUE ~ 'worked examples'),
    `What it does` = map_chr(Script, first_comment), Lines = map_int(Script, ~ length(readLines(here(.x))))) |>
  show_table('scripts', caption = '**Every script `R/run_all.R` runs, in order.**')
```

## Outputs

Every file under `output/` is declared in `R/helpers/paths.R`; a script cannot write an
undeclared output. Folders hold one file per table, in the folder of the step that writes it.

```{r}
files = list.files(here('output'), recursive = TRUE)
files = files[!startsWith(files, 'cache/')]
describe = function(step, file) {
  first = sub('/.*$', '', file)
  i = match(first, OUTPUT_REGISTRY$name)
  if (is.na(i)) i = which(startsWith(first, OUTPUT_REGISTRY$name) & grepl('^[(]prefix[)]', OUTPUT_REGISTRY$description))[1]
  if (is.na(i)) i = match(step, OUTPUT_REGISTRY$name)
  sub('^[(]prefix[)] ', '', OUTPUT_REGISTRY$description[i])
}
tibble(path = files, Step = sub('/.*$', '', path), File = sub('^[^/]+/', '', path)) |>
  mutate(Description = map2_chr(Step, File, describe), `Size (kB)` = round(file.size(here('output', path)) / 1024)) |>
  select(Step, File, Description, `Size (kB)`) |>
  show_table('outputs', caption = sprintf('**%d output files** (excluding the climate and age-draw cache).', length(files)))
```

The cache (`output/cache/`) holds the downloaded CHELSA V2.1 and CHELSA-TraCE21k chunks and the
1,000 seeded Bacon age draws per sample; an `--offline` run needs nothing else.

## Figures

```{r}
figs = list.files(here('report/figures'), recursive = TRUE, pattern = '[.](pdf|png)$')
figs = figs[!startsWith(figs, 'png/')]
tibble(Figure = figs) |> mutate(Folder = sub('/.*$', '', Figure)) |> count(Folder, name = 'Files') |>
  show_table('figure_folders', caption = '**Figure files by folder** (`report/figures/png/` holds the previews built for this report).')
```
